originality.rationale: The four direction-sensitive, position-indexed covariances jointly couple an existing natural peak/valley orientation taxonomy to a disjoint-cycle global statistic. Known stronger peak/cycle and descent-set/cycle generating functions cover un-oriented or descent-determined coarsenings but do not distinguish 132 from 231, or 213 from 312. Fu–Li refines peak orientation but without cycles. Full-text comparisons and semantic searches found no covering four-row mixed formula; indirect historical generators remain a stated risk.
